title: Unsupported spell narrated as attempt only
description: The player casts a spell the engine does not resolve. The honest narration describes the attempt and nothing else; the boundary must have nothing to remove.
player_input: I cast Wish to bring my brother back.

play.consequence_planner.mechanical_summary: Lyra attempts to cast Wish. The engine has no effect for this spell, so nothing changes.

scripted.play.narrator: You begin the words, but nothing answers them and your brother stays where he is. The attempt leaves you tired and empty-handed. What do you do next?
